target_customer: Small and mid-size US law firms (business, transactional, employment and corporate practices)
problem: Lawyers spend most of their day on unpaid admin such as intake, conflict checks, document chasing and billing, and slow replies lose clients.
business_model: B2B SaaS for law firms, pricing not published (early access)

founders.name: Diana Khramina
prior_employers: Gorgias (GTM lead of AI Agent, earlier Chief of Staff to the CEO)
founders.background_notes: YC page says she scaled Gorgias's AI Agent to 1,000+ paying customers and $8M ARR in under a year.

founders.name: Maxence Guegnolle--Santi
founders.background_notes: Launch post says he comes from a family of lawyers.

competitors.name: Eve
competitors.what: AI intake specialist for plaintiffs firms

competitors.name: Lawmatics QualifyAI
competitors.what: AI agent that qualifies and prioritizes law firm leads

competitors.name: Clio Grow AI
competitors.what: 24/7 AI intake agents inside Clio's intake product

technical_complexity.rationale: Orchestrating agents across email, calendar, e-signature, billing and practice management tools with lawyer approval steps is integration-heavy but uses existing models.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations and workflow lock-in help, but incumbents such as Clio and Lawmatics are adding AI intake to products firms already use.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Practice management vendors shipped AI intake features in 2026 around the batch. No acquisition of Praxis found.

market_need_then: Founders quote a law firm owner losing three to five clients per month at about $10K each; the site cites 62 percent of lawyer time on admin (company claims, unverified). Law firms were buying AI intake tools in 2025 and 2026.

branding.domain_note: Uses runpraxis.ai because the plain name is in wide use; many other companies are called Praxis.

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and direct: 'Agents do the work, lawyers approve'

branding.brand_signature: Agents do the work, lawyers approve

brand_strength.rationale: Clear tagline but a very common name that collides with several other Praxis companies, including another YC company, and no brand press.

outcome_analysis: Praxis is a two-person Fall 2026 company with a strong go-to-market founder from Gorgias and an AI engineer. It says it is live with US law firms but has no public funding or press beyond a Fondo write-up. Competition from incumbent practice management tools is intensifying, so the outcome is open.
notes: No funding information found beyond YC membership. A search summary said the company is Paris-based per one directory; the YC page says San Francisco. The Eve source_date is the June 2025 beta announcement. Many unrelated companies named Praxis were returned and excluded. Confidence medium: founders and competition sourced, funding not.
